newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metals names Charles Shaver COO.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metals names Charles Shaver COO.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology Inc said Friday that it has promoted Charles Shaver to the newly created position of chief operating officer.
Shaver, said the company, joined Molten Metal Technology in August as vice president of manufacturing after 16 years at Dow Chemical Co.

Effective immediately, Shaver will lead day-to-day company operations, overseeing all efforts in design and development, government and external affairs, management information systems and procurement.

The company also said it has promoted Earl McConchie to vice president of sales and marketing. McConchie, who joined Molten Metal Technology in April as head of the company's chemicals and plastics business, also formerly worked at Dow.
Molten Metal Technology is an environmental technology company.
